Name: Porter-Cable
description: The Porter-Cable 6 Gallon Oil Free Pancake Compressor delivers 2.6 SCFM at 90 PSI with a 150 PSI max, featuring a lightweight 30 lb pancake-style tank and durable oil-free pump for easy transport and maintenance-free use. Ideal for DIYers and home workshop users.

Name: Rolair
description: The Rolair VT25BIG Direct Drive Air Compressor delivers 6.5 CFM at 90 PSI with a 2.5 HP motor, cast-iron cylinder, and splash lubrication for durability. Its folding handle and flat-free tires enhance jobsite mobility, perfect for heavy-duty contractors.

Name: Makita
description: The Makita MAC5200 Big Bore Air Compressor features a 3.0 HP motor delivering 6.5 CFM at 90 PSI, with a cast-iron pump, roll cage, and oil-lubricated cooling system, ideal for professional contractors needing durable, high-output air supply.

Name: DEWALT
description: The DEWALT 225 PSI Vertical Air Compressor offers 5.0 SCFM at 90 PSI, 78 dBA quiet operation, and vertical storage with a collapsible handle, combining space-saving design and high performance for roofing, framing, and finish nailers.

Name: Chicago Pneumatic
description: The Chicago Pneumatic CP3850 series includes 2.8 hp angle grinders and sanders built for 7” and 9” wheels, featuring a 2,000-hour bevel gear, adjustable exhaust, and anti-vibration handles—ideal for industrial metalwork professionals.

Name: Quincy Compressor
description: The Quincy QGS Rotary Screw Air Compressor ranges from 5 to 100 hp with tank and dryer options, offering quiet operation, low oil carryover, and 8,000-hour lubricant—ideal for continuous-duty use in industrial and manufacturing sectors.
